summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Resume Score system for RealProfits Resume Builder. All 14 test cases passed. Deterministic scoring (100 points across 5 categories) working correctly with real-time updates, Fix button navigation, and Smart/AI Improve dual buttons.
passed_tests: Test 1: Score Panel Visibility - data-testid='resume-score-panel' exists with score circle, 5 category bars, and suggestions
Test 2: Initial Score - Empty resume shows score 10 (only ATS Safety 10/10)
Test 3: Real-time Completeness - Name (+5) and email (+5) increase score to 20 without refresh
Test 4: Summary Scoring - Summary >50 words increases score (17 after summary)
Test 5: Experience Scoring - Experience with action verbs and numbers increases score significantly (47 after experience)
Test 6: Skills Scoring - Adding 3+ skills increases Completeness score (+5)
Test 7: Fix Button Navigation - Skills Fix navigates to Skills tab
Test 8: Suggestion Severity Order - Critical (red) suggestions appear before medium (blue)
Test 9: Smart Improve Button - Teal button visible with Wand2 icon on summary and bullets
Test 9: AI Improve Button - Violet button visible with Sparkles icon, counter shows 3/3
Test 10: Smart Suggestions - Grammarly-style suggestions detect weak phrases ('hard worker', 'helped with')
Test 11: Comprehensive Resume Score 70+ - Score reached 73 with label 'Good' (teal)
Test 12: Homepage loads correctly with hero section and navigation
Test 13: Fix Button for Experience - Navigates to Experience tab AND triggers addExperience()
Test 14: Fix Button for Education - Navigates to Education tab AND triggers addEducation()
Suggestions show '+Xpts' indicating points to gain
Category bars fill proportionally (Completeness 30/30, Quality 13/25, Impact 13/25, Structure 7/10, ATS 10/10)
test_credentials: No auth required. Score is 100% client-side deterministic calculation.
seed_data_creation: None required - uses localStorage for resume data (key: resume_builder) and AI usage tracking (key: rp_ai_uses_v2)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resume Score system fully tested. Key data-testid attributes: resume-score-panel, resume-score-circle, resume-score-number, resume-score-suggestions, score-suggestion-{0-7}, fix-action-{0-7}, score-all-clear. Score breakdown: Completeness (30pts: name=5, email=5, summary>50words=5, experience>0=5, education>0=5, skills>=3=5), Quality (25pts: action verbs), Impact (25pts: numbers/metrics), Structure (10pts: bullet count, summary length), ATS (10pts: special chars, email format). Fix buttons call handleFixAction which sets activeTab and may trigger addExperience() or addEducation(). Score updates via useMemo on every data change. To test empty state: localStorage.removeItem('resume_builder'). Smart Improve (teal) is rule-based free. AI Improve (violet) is limited to 3 uses.
